description: Look up a VerusID by name or i-address. Returns the identity's current state including primary addresses, signing authorities, content data (contentmultimap), revocation/recovery authorities, and wallet relationship (canspendfor/cansignfor). Optionally retrieve the identity as it existed at a specific block height. Use this to check if an identity exists, inspect its configuration, or verify wallet authority before performing write operations.

height.description: Return identity as of this block height. Default: current height. Pass -1 to include mempool.

txproof.description: If true, returns a proof of the identity. Default: false.

txproofheight.description: Height from which to generate the proof. Default: same as height.

name: getidentity
